verdict.rationale: Smithery Connect proxied tool calls, so an audit log of those calls is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item documents tool-call logging, audit trails, or replay. Token scoping (who can call tools) is an adjacent access control, not a call log, and the connection services have since been shut down, leaving only a non-proxied registry.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
